title: Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.7 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.4 fails to check forwarded trailers against the…
description: Wasmtime versions 46.0.0 before 48.0.7 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.4 contain a vulnerability where forwarded trailers in HTTP requests or responses are not properly checked against the WasiHttpHooks::is_forbidden_header hook in wasi-http p3. This allows WASIp3 guests to bypass embedder-customized forbidden header filtering, potentially undermining intended header restrictions.
